QUESTIONS.title: Are permission deny rules set for paths and actions the agent must never touch?
QUESTIONS.detail: Include production-sensitive paths and genuinely read-only passes.

QUESTIONS.title: Is branch protection enforced on the server, with direct push and force-push blocked and no owner bypass?
QUESTIONS.detail: The deploy route and the destination branch must both be gated.

QUESTIONS.title: Are test files protected from agent edits, with Git history used as the account of what changed?
QUESTIONS.detail: The agent should not be able to rewrite the evidence behind its own claim.

QUESTIONS.title: Do hooks gate tool use and the end of a turn?
QUESTIONS.detail: Read before write or claim, destructive-command refusal, outbound confirmation, conversation capture and evidence checks.

QUESTIONS.title: Does work carry safely into a new session and survive compaction?
QUESTIONS.detail: Claude reloads root instructions itself. Check the prior-work digest, critical open files and end-of-session compliance.

QUESTIONS.title: Does CI require committed evidence and verify that its own checks ran?
QUESTIONS.detail: Include test output, generated files, source-read evidence, merged-result checks and the missing stronger test suites.

QUESTIONS.title: Is the work record append-only, complete, and linked to task, scope, commits and landing state?
QUESTIONS.detail: The ticket and model seat should travel with the code, and the published view should derive from the repository.

QUESTIONS.title: Are calls recorded and changing facts read live from their source?
QUESTIONS.detail: Do not rely on memory, a discarded source, or a hand-maintained copy.

QUESTIONS.title: Is every change outside Claude’s direct edits protected by a usable restore path?
QUESTIONS.detail: Claude checkpoints direct edits automatically. Cover shell changes, tracked working folders, migration snapshots, reversal scripts and snapshot age.

QUESTIONS.title: Are parallel writers isolated and independent review assigned to a different model seat?
QUESTIONS.detail: Desktop sessions get separate worktrees automatically; CLI sessions and subagents need explicit isolation. Model-seat separation keeps the audit independent.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Permission deny rules
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Set deny rules for the writable surface and standing don’ts.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Claude Code Plan Mode
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Use Claude Code’s native Plan Mode for review-only work so the session can explore but cannot edit source files.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Server-side branch protection
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Protect the destination branch, block direct and force pushes, and remove owner bypass.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Hard block destructive commands
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Add explicit deny rules or a PreToolUse hook for destructive project commands. This remains useful after a user has granted a standing Bash permission.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Outbound-action confirmation
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Put email, deploy, payment and other external side effects behind a human confirm gate.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Read-before-write and read-before-claim gates
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Require a confirmed source read before a write or factual claim.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Durable decision capture
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Promote new rules, decisions and findings into durable project files at turn end. Claude’s local session transcript is useful history, but it is not the project’s system of record.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Post-compaction working-set check
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Re-read critical open sources and trigger nested or path-scoped rules after compaction. Root-level instructions reload automatically.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Cross-session handoff and end check
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Carry a short prior-work digest into a new session or agent, then check compliance before the turn ends. Resuming the same Claude session restores its history automatically.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Scope diff and turn-ending checks
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Diff touched files against declared scope and prevent a turn ending without its required record.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Committed-evidence CI gates
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Gate on committed test output, generated files, source reads, merged artefacts and proof that each gate ran.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Call recording and transcript capture
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Turn on recording and file every transcript.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Live source reads
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Read changing facts from the live system instead of a copied figure.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Tracked working folders
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Bring every writable working path under version control.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Snapshot freshness alert
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Alert on the age of the last usable snapshot.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Recovery scope and authority
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Write down what each restore point covers and who has authority to call a rollback.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Append-only task and commit record
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Require a task, validate the record, preserve its history, link commits, and derive the published view from the repository.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Worktree isolation outside Desktop
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Use --worktree for parallel CLI sessions and worktree isolation for subagents. Claude Code Desktop already gives each new session its own worktree.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Test-file write protection
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Withhold test-file writes from the agent and preserve Git history as the record.

INSTALL_GROUPS.title: Independent model-seat separation
INSTALL_GROUPS.install: Assign the audit to a different model seat from the one that did the work.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Define the job and what will count as done
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: State the goal, intended files, limits, whether examples are illustrative, and the evidence required for acceptance.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: The brief can be checked against the final diff and artefacts.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Load the sources you expect the work to rely on
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Name where facts come from and show the search before treating an absence as a finding.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: The working sources and important caveats are explicit.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Confirm access, workspace and other active writers
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Check the credential in use, keep permissions on, confirm the local client route, and give each session its own workspace and marker.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: You know what the session can reach and who else can write here.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Create the migration recovery path before changing data
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Take the snapshot, write the reversal, copy and verify before deleting, and decide the point where recovery should stop.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: A dated restore point and executable reversal both exist.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Give each agent an isolated writable tree
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Allocate one worktree per writer before the fan-out begins.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: No two agents can write the same tree.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Keep claims grounded and carry caveats forward
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Ask instead of estimating, and repeat confidence limits wherever a fact or finding travels.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: Every load-bearing claim has a source or is visibly marked unknown.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Record decisions and reasons while they are fresh
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Write the full decision, rationale, constraints and reopen condition into the durable work record as they happen.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: Someone reading the record later can tell what was decided, why and for which task.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Save useful work incrementally
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Write partial results to disk, and feed completed output into a retry instead of starting again.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: A stopped or retried run would retain the work already completed.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Gather every agent before the parent finishes
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Use a synthesis stage that waits for, reconciles and preserves every child result.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: No child output is stranded or silently overwritten.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Inspect the real change, not the success report
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Read the repository diff and actual artefacts on the target branch, then compare them with the decision record.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: The accepted result is visible in the files and branch that will actually land.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Run the evidence and keep its output
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Execute the relevant behavioural, generated-file, claim, architecture, accessibility and adversarial checks; add the regression test for a late bug.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: The output is committed or independently reproducible, not merely asserted.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Confirm the release can be reversed as one unit
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Check that code and data come back together before approving the release or external action.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: The rollback restores the whole system state, not only the code.

WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.title: Make the judgement no tool can make for you
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.instruction: Decide whether the finding, data model, security design, public claim and remaining risk are genuinely acceptable.
WORKFLOW_ACTIONS.doneWhen: A named person has made and recorded each consequential judgement.
